# Reactor Defense: TD

> Reactor Defense: TD is an offline sci-fi tower defense game for iPhone and Android, made by Roboschnoz Gaming. Players build and evolve turrets to stop machines from reaching their reactor core. The game is free with limited ads, has a one-time purchase to remove them, and has no pay-to-win.

## Key facts

- Genre: tower defense, strategy
- Platform: iPhone (App Store) and Android (Google Play)
- Price: free with limited ads; a one-time purchase removes ads
- Internet: not required, the whole game plays offline and needs no account
- Turrets: 12 base turrets that evolve into stronger forms
- Progression: Mastery XP carries across runs and unlocks evolutions and upgrades
- Enemies: an AI that adapts to how the player builds
- Monetization: limited ads, optional one-time ad removal, no pay-to-win
- Developer: Roboschnoz Gaming
